podcast.title: Influence on Public Image Limited
podcast.body: Johnny Lydon drew heavily from 1970s German rock music as an influence for the experimental style of Public Image Limited. "He listened to a lot of German rock from the 70s."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Reunions: Some Lasted....and Sadly, Some Didn't ｜ Part 2

podcast.title: Self-Reference and British Naming
podcast.body: German musicians and fans initially referred to their distinct new sound as "German rock" or "Doitsch German Rock." However, the British bestowed the name "Krautrock," initially as a pejorative, which ultimately stuck despite German disapproval. "The Germans just called it German rock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
